groundcheck.description: Trust-weighted memory system. ALWAYS call crt_check_memory at the start of every turn to load relevant context and auto-store facts. Call crt_verify_output before responding with factual claims about the user. Call crt_store_fact for explicit corrections.

crt.description: CRT cognitive trust engine. Call crt_get_user_context at session start to load user profile and preferences. Use crt_search_sessions to find relevant past conversations. Use crt_get_pending_fact_checks to surface auto-detected issues.
